Subject: Context profile & unit-econ checkpoint for Helmshore POC

Hi Ari — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick post-call recap and a handful of asks so we can lock the POC economics. Notes below are intentionally concrete so we can model costs for the two POC flows you described (support search assistant + weekly analytics batch):

1) Usage & volume ranges (please confirm):
   - Expected monthly active requests: 150k–400k (spiky weekdays)
   - Target monthly token volume (combined prompts + completions): 25M–80M tokens

2) Context & length profile (your call + our initial sampling):
   - Short/8k flow (UI chat / single doc summary): ~68% of calls
   - Mid/32k flow (multi-doc retrieval + context stitching): ~27% of calls
   - Long/128k flow (full-article ingest + analytics adjacency): ~5% of calls

3) Avg token mix (we used the sample you uploaded 'helmshore_context_sample.csv'):
   - Avg prompt tokens (per request): 310 tokens
   - Avg completion tokens (per request): 640 tokens
   - Prompt:Completion ratio ~ 1:2.1

4) Unit-econ target & rate request:
   - You mentioned wanting to target a cost near $/1M-tokens that supports a $15k–$45k monthly production budget.
   - To hit $20k/month on ~30M tokens we'd need ~$$0.67–$0.75 per 1k tokens equivalent (roughly $670–$750 per 1M tokens).
   - For modeling, we should set an internal target band of $650–$900 per 1M tokens depending on model size and context bucket (8k < 32k < 128k).

5) Immediate asks / next steps:
   - Ari: can you confirm the monthly token range (min/expected/max) and expected % of traffic in each context bucket?
   - Procurement: please confirm any PO/contracting cadence and if we should include a reserved-capacity (Dedicated) pricing row vs hosted.
   - Internal: Marissa/Karthik — I'll attach a first-pass estimate; please flag any discounts we should bake for a 12-month commit.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_estimate_v2.xlsx (first pass; assumptions tab included)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a line-item cost model assuming three context-tier unit prices (8k, 32k, 128k) once we get your confirmation on volumes.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Sean — thanks for the thorough recap. A few clarifications from our side after reviewing the sample:

- Monthly tokens: we think production will land between 20M (conservative) and 50M (aggressive) tokens for the first 6 months. Sandbox/dev usage (~2–3M tokens) will be separate.
- Context buckets: your split aligns well with our telemetry. I’d tweak the mid bucket to 30% and long to 2–3% (we overestimated long calls in the sample because of a small analytics subset).
- Token mix in our real traces (5k random calls): avg prompt ~360, avg completion ~590 (so ~1:1.6 prompt:completion), but it varies by flow. Support assistant completions are shorter; analytics jobs produce the long completions.

Budget & unit-econ: procurement gave me ranges — they’d prefer a target near $600 per 1M tokens if feasible for hosted; if Dedicated/reserved we could stretch to $450 per 1M with a 12-month commit and a minimum monthly spend.

PO cadence: procurement wants a draft SOW + pricing sheet to review by EOD Friday. Can you return an updated estimate (breakdown by context bucket and model family) and mark which rows are eligible for commit discounts?

Thanks — attaching a short note from procurement for the legal/PO contact (see next message).

— Ari
Head of AI Products, Helmshore

Hi Ari / Myra — looping in Karthik from pricing. Per Sean's ask and your procurement checklist, attached is an updated worksheet (redwood_pricing_estimate_v2.xlsx) with:

- Three context-tier rows (8k / 32k / 128k) with example unit prices, effective $/1M-tokens, and a blended case based on the 20M–50M token bands you provided.
- Two scenarios: Hosted (no commit) and Dedicated 12-month commit (includes reserved capacity discount + throughput SLA).
- Commit discounts we modeled: 18–28% depending on commit level and context usage mix. Dedicated entry pricing example (blended) lands at roughly $420–$520 per 1M tokens for a 12-mo, 75% committed utilization case.
- Sandbox/dev and dev/test rows separated so procurement can see excluded traffic.

Action items:
  1) Ari/Myra: confirm a single expected monthly volume line (pick a conservative and aggressive number) so we can finalize the PO template.
  2) Myra: please share any non-standard T&Cs or security annex language asap; we'll flag changes in the SOW.
  3) Sean/Karthik: if we offer a step discount at 3-tier commit thresholds (6k, 12k, 24k monthly commit), do you want those in the table or should we present a simple 12-month commit vs hosted option?

I put comments on the spreadsheet with the assumptions we used for avg prompt/completion tokens per bucket. If helpful we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough tomorrow.

Thanks — Marissa
